headline_item.title_zh: Reddit上线AI驱动产品评测中心
headline_item.title_en: Reddit launches Reddit Reviews, a built-in hub using AI to turn subreddit comments into product pages with pros, cons, and sentiment, starting with 10K items (Mia Sato/The Verge)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: Reddit推出Reddit Reviews功能，利用AI自动抓取社区讨论生成包含优缺点的产品评测页
headline_item.event_summary_en: Reddit launched a product review hub that uses AI to analyze and summarize millions of subreddit discussions into structured product pages covering 10,000 items. This initiative aims to monetize the platform's reputation for authentic user recommendations while challenging traditional review outlets.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Reddit官方在Reddit平台内设评测频道：上线Reddit Reviews，利用AI将社区评论转化为包含优缺点总结的产品信息页
【起因与机理】利用社区真实口碑变现，争夺消费导购搜索流量
【关键技术规格】Reddit官方进军电商评测领域。
【观点态度】意在挖掘社区口碑变现价值并挑战传统测评媒体。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Reddit (On-platform product review hub): Launched 'Reddit Reviews' to aggregate subreddit discussions into AI-summarized product pages with pros and cons
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To monetize authentic community data and capture e-commerce discovery traffic
[Key Specification] Reddit enters the e-commerce review space.
[Perspective & Impact] Seeking to monetize community trust and compete with traditional media.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 以前大家查产品是“去百度查广告，来Reddit看真话”，现在Reddit把真话喂给AI做成页面，本质上是把自家社区最值钱的“野生经验”收割打包成电商流量入口。虽然说是为了方便用户，但以后在Reddit搜产品怕是也要先过一遍算法过滤了，真正的“纯天然”评价只会越来越稀缺。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Reddit used to be the place where you go to find real talk after suffering through ad-filled Google results; now they're just training AI to package that 'real talk' into a shiny product hub. It's a classic move: monetize the soul of your community before someone else does, but don't be surprised when the authentic vibe starts feeling like a sanitized shopping catalog.

人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
